idea-plugin.name: EPUB Accessibility Metadata Lint (EAA)
idea-plugin.description:
18 rules over the accessibility metadata in your .opf: 12 findings in the sample file, 9 of them errors, 6 of them invented or malformed values

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → EPUB Accessibility Metadata Lint (EAA): Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 18 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/epub-a11y-metadata-lint (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/epub-a11y-metadata-lint
